scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:integration: SPECTRO_INTEGRATION=1 pnpm --filter @spectro/integration-tests test && pnpm --filter @spectro/api test:integration && pnpm test:ops
scripts.auth:local:prepare: pnpm auth:local:setup && docker compose -f infra/auth-local/compose.yaml up -d --wait && pnpm --filter @spectro/api... --filter @spectro/web... build && node --env-file=.env.auth-local apps/api/dist/migrate.js
scripts.auth:local:test-ingestion: SPECTRO_INTEGRATION=1 pnpm --filter @spectro/integration-tests exec node --env-file=../../.env.auth-local --env-file=../../.env.ingest-local node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run hosted-ingestion.integration.test.ts
